errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no bundle under this identifier that this producer may act on. Deliberately conflates "no such bundle" with "not yours" — see Correlation.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

aborted.description: Whether this request is what moved the bundle to a terminal state. False means it was already terminal — a success, not a failure, and the reason abort can be retried safely. Required rather than optional: an absent member on an idempotent no-op would be indistinguishable from a cancellation that happened.

bundleId.description: Echoed so the response stands alone as a record.

schema.description: Cancels an in-flight export or import bundle and discards its staged bytes. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

bundleId.description: Handle from an initiate-export or initiate-import descriptor; either kind is accepted. Opaque: a producer quotes what it was given and must not derive, guess or enumerate one.
